Class RecipeSearchTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
be.henallux.project.view.RecipeSearchTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public class RecipeSearchTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
Table model used to display a list of Recipe instances in a JTable.

This model provides read-only access to recipe data and defines the structure of the table, including name, document information, and an action column ("See Recipe").

The model is updated by replacing the underlying dataset via setRecipes(List).

    • getValueAt

      public Object getValueAt(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
      Returns the value displayed in a specific cell of the recipe table.

      Column mapping:

      • recipe name
      • recipe document ID
      • comma-separated list of product names in the recipe composition
      • action label ("See Recipe")

      the value displayed in the table cell

    • getCompositionLabel

      public String getCompositionLabel(List<RecipeComposition> compositions)
      Builds a human-readable label representing the composition of a recipe.

      The label is created by concatenating all product names contained in the RecipeComposition list, separated by commas.

      If no valid product names are available, a fallback "-" is returned.

      Parameters:
      compositions - the list of recipe composition entries
      Returns:
      a formatted string representing the recipe contents
